title: Fully-populated VC fund entry
description: Exercises every field of the vc_fund block — checkSize as an amountRange with both bounds, denominated in the document-wide fundingInfo.currency, the stages enum, thesis, portfolio, the contactMethod enum, and activelyInvesting. A fund is an ongoing source of capital rather than a round, so the document carries no deadlines array at all.

fundingDetails.thesis: Ethereum-native infrastructure and developer tooling, entering at the first institutional check.
